description: This file defines a VGG-based backbone model for RetinaNet object detection, including utility functions for model creation, weight downloading, and image preprocessing.

classes.name: VGGBackbone
classes.description: A class representing the VGG backbone with methods for model retrieval, weight downloading, validation, and image preprocessing.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Constructs a RetinaNet model using the VGG backbone.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Downloads ImageNet weights for VGG16 or VGG19 backbones.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the backbone string is either 'vgg16' or 'vgg19'.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Preprocesses an input image for the VGG network.
